answer.reason: Several verses state that Paul sent Tychicus on missions, which goes beyond the summary's companionship.

clauses.english: was sent by Paul to the Colossians to declare his state and comfort their hearts
clauses.quote: Whom I have sent unto you for the same purpose, that he might know your estate, and comfort your hearts;

clauses.english: was sent by Paul to Ephesus
clauses.quote: And Tychicus have I sent to Ephesus.

doubts: EPH 6:21-22 describes a similar sending to the Ephesians, but it was left out as a near repeat of the Colossians clause.
The closing notes in EPH 6:24 and COL 4:18 saying the letters were written by Tychicus were not used, since they are later subscriptions rather than part of the text.
TIT 3:12 only says Paul may send Tychicus, so it was not used.
